verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.197

verses.pali: 20. Mahāvagga
verses.english: 20. The Great Chapter

verses.pali: Mallikādevīsutta
verses.english: Queen Mallikā

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho mallikā devī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnā kho mallikā devī bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Queen Mallikā went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
verses.english: “What is the cause, sir, what is the reason why in this life some ladies are ugly, unattractive, and bad-looking;

verses.pali: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca?
verses.english: and poor, with few assets and possessions; and insignificant?

verses.pali: Ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
verses.english: And why are some ladies ugly, unattractive, and bad-looking;

verses.pali: aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā mahābhogā mahesakkhā ca?
verses.english: but rich, affluent, wealthy, and illustrious?

verses.pali: Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā;
verses.english: And why are some ladies attractive, good-looking, lovely, of surpassing beauty;

verses.pali: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca?
verses.english: but poor, with few assets and possessions; and insignificant?

verses.pali: Ko pana, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā, aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā mahābhogā mahesakkhā cā”ti?
verses.english: And why are some ladies attractive, good-looking, lovely, of surpassing beauty; and rich, affluent, wealthy, and illustrious?”

verses.pali: “Idha, mallike, ekacco mātugāmo kodhanā hoti upāyāsabahulā.
verses.english: “Take a lady who is irritable and bad-tempered.

verses.pali: Appampi vuttā samānā abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
verses.english: Even when criticized a little bit she loses her temper, becoming annoyed, hostile, and hard-hearted, and displaying annoyance, hate, and bitterness.

verses.pali: Sā na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṁ pānaṁ vatthaṁ yānaṁ mālāgandhavilepanaṁ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṁ.
verses.english: She doesn’t give to ascetics or brahmins such things as food, drink, clothing, vehicles; garlands, fragrance, and makeup; and bed, house, and lighting.

verses.pali: Issāmanikā kho pana hoti;
verses.english: And she’s jealous,

verses.pali: paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu issati upadussati issaṁ bandhati.
verses.english: envying, resenting, and begrudging the possessions, honor, respect, reverence, homage, and veneration given to others.

verses.pali: Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṁ āgacchati, sā yattha yattha paccājāyati dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
verses.english: If she comes back to this place after passing away, wherever she is reborn she’s ugly, unattractive, and bad-looking;

verses.pali: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca.
verses.english: and poor, with few assets and possessions; and insignificant.

verses.pali: Idha pana, mallike, ekacco mātugāmo kodhanā hoti upāyāsabahulā.
verses.english: Take another lady who is irritable and bad-tempered. …

verses.pali: Appampi vuttā samānā abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
Sā dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṁ pānaṁ vatthaṁ yānaṁ mālāgandhavilepanaṁ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṁ.
verses.english: But she does give to ascetics or brahmins …

verses.pali: Anissāmanikā kho pana hoti;
verses.english: And she’s not jealous …

verses.pali: paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na issati na upadussati na issaṁ bandhati.
Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṁ āgacchati, sā yattha yattha paccājāyati dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
verses.english: If she comes back to this place after passing away, wherever she is reborn she’s ugly, unattractive, and bad-looking;

verses.pali: aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā mahābhogā mahesakkhā ca.
verses.english: but rich, affluent, wealthy, and illustrious.

verses.pali: Idha pana, mallike, ekacco mātugāmo akkodhanā hoti anupāyāsabahulā.
verses.english: Take another lady who isn’t irritable and bad-tempered. …

verses.pali: Bahumpi vuttā samānā nābhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patitthīyati, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
Sā na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṁ pānaṁ vatthaṁ yānaṁ mālāgandhavilepanaṁ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṁ.
verses.english: But she doesn’t give to ascetics or brahmins …

verses.pali: Issāmanikā kho pana hoti;
verses.english: And she’s jealous …

verses.pali: paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu issati upadussati issaṁ bandhati.
Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṁ āgacchati, sā yattha yattha paccājāyati abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā;
verses.english: If she comes back to this place after passing away, wherever she is reborn she’s attractive, good-looking, lovely, of surpassing beauty;

verses.pali: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca.
verses.english: but poor, with few assets and possessions; and insignificant.

verses.pali: Idha pana, mallike, ekacco mātugāmo akkodhanā hoti anupāyāsabahulā.
verses.english: Take another lady who isn’t irritable and bad-tempered. …

verses.pali: Bahumpi vuttā samānā nābhisajjati na kuppati na byāpajjati na patitthīyati, na kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
Sā dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṁ pānaṁ vatthaṁ yānaṁ mālāgandhavilepanaṁ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṁ.
verses.english: She gives to ascetics and brahmins …

verses.pali: Anissāmanikā kho pana hoti;
verses.english: And she’s not jealous …

verses.pali: paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na issati na upadussati na issaṁ bandhati.
Sā ce tato cutā itthattaṁ āgacchati, sā yattha yattha paccājāyati abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā;
verses.english: If she comes back to this place after passing away, wherever she is reborn she’s attractive, good-looking, lovely, of surpassing beauty;

verses.pali: aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā mahābhogā mahesakkhā ca.
verses.english: and rich, affluent, wealthy, and illustrious.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, mallike, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
verses.english: This is why some ladies are ugly …

verses.pali: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca.
verses.english: and poor … and insignificant.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ pana, mallike, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya;
verses.english: And some ladies are ugly …

verses.pali: aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā mahābhogā mahesakkhā ca.
verses.english: but rich … and illustrious.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, mallike, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā;
verses.english: And some ladies are attractive …

verses.pali: daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā appesakkhā ca.
verses.english: but poor … and insignificant.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ pana, mallike, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena midhekacco mātugāmo abhirūpā ca hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā;
verses.english: And some ladies are attractive …

verses.pali: aḍḍhā ca hoti mahaddhanā mahābhogā mahesakkhā cā”ti.
verses.english: and rich … and illustrious.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, mallikā devī bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When this was said, Queen Mallikā said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “yā nūnāhaṁ, bhante, aññaṁ jātiṁ kodhanā ahosiṁ upāyāsabahulā,
verses.english: “Sir, in another life I must have been irritable and bad-tempered.

verses.pali: appampi vuttā samānā abhisajjiṁ kuppiṁ byāpajjiṁ patitthīyiṁ kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātvākāsiṁ,
verses.english: Even when lightly criticized I must have lost my temper, becoming annoyed, hostile, and hard-hearted, and displaying annoyance, hate, and bitterness.

verses.pali: sāhaṁ, bhante, etarahi dubbaṇṇā durūpā supāpikā dassanāya.
verses.english: For now I am ugly, unattractive, and bad-looking.

verses.pali: Yā nūnāhaṁ, bhante, aññaṁ jātiṁ dātā ahosiṁ samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṁ pānaṁ vatthaṁ yānaṁ mālāgandhavilepanaṁ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṁ, sāhaṁ, bhante, etarahi aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā.
verses.english: In another life I must have given to ascetics or brahmins such things as food, drink, clothing, vehicles; garlands, fragrance, and makeup; and bed, house, and lighting. For now I am rich, affluent, and wealthy.

verses.pali: Yā nūnāhaṁ, bhante, aññaṁ jātiṁ anissāmanikā ahosiṁ, paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na issiṁ na upadussiṁ na issaṁ bandhiṁ, sāhaṁ, bhante, etarahi mahesakkhā.
verses.english: In another life, I must not have been jealous, envying, resenting, and begrudging the possessions, honor, respect, reverence, homage, and veneration given to others. For now I am illustrious.

verses.pali: Santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṁ rājakule khattiyakaññāpi brāhmaṇakaññāpi gahapatikaññāpi, tāsāhaṁ issarādhipaccaṁ kāremi.
verses.english: In this royal court I command maidens of the aristocrats, brahmins, and householders.

verses.pali: Esāhaṁ, bhante, ajjatagge akkodhanā bhavissāmi anupāyāsabahulā,
verses.english: So, sir, from this day forth I will not be irritable and bad-tempered.

verses.pali: bahumpi vuttā samānā nābhisajjissāmi na kuppissāmi na byāpajjissāmi na patitthīyissāmi, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca na pātukarissāmi;
verses.english: Even when heavily criticized I won’t lose my temper, become annoyed, hostile, and hard-hearted, or display annoyance, hate, and bitterness.

verses.pali: dassāmi samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṁ pānaṁ vatthaṁ yānaṁ mālāgandhavilepanaṁ seyyāvasathapadīpeyyaṁ.
verses.english: I will give to ascetics or brahmins such things as food, drink, clothing, vehicles; garlands, fragrance, and makeup; and bed, house, and lighting.

verses.pali: Anissāmanikā bhavissāmi, paralābhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu na ississāmi na upadussissāmi na issaṁ bandhissāmi.
verses.english: I will not be jealous, envying, resenting, and begrudging the possessions, honor, respect, reverence, homage, and veneration given to others.

verses.pali: Abhikkantaṁ, bhante …pe… upāsikaṁ maṁ, bhante, bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: Excellent, sir! … From this day forth, may the Buddha remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”

verses.pali: Sattamaṁ.
